name: Jordan Hale
resumeText:
Jordan Hale
Full-stack engineer

Harbor (Jun 2025 – Sep 2026)
Built a multi-tenant web app for small studios. Email and password auth with server sessions, a REST API for projects and membership, and a React client. I wrote the schema, the login flow, and most of the API. There is a smoke test around login, and the rest of the coverage is thin. The project is real and modest. It does not move streaming data.
